items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: If you look on the back there, it was recorded the day Kennedy got killed, November 22, we were in the studio recording that day.

ctx.x: Yeah, most of it was, but it was also like there’s an album called “Woody Herman 1964” on the Phillips label. If you look on the back there, it was recorded the day Kennedy got killed, November 22, we were in the studio recording that day. And I had just — my second daughter was born, and I was kind of —you know, the President gets killed, my daughter was born with a liver problem, I’m on the road, I didn’t really like it, so I just said who needs it, so I left. And those other two incidents helped me make my…
He had quite a character on baritone for a while, was it Serge?
